opportunities.name: Family call prep email (local time + forecast)
opportunities.description: For a relative living in city X, look up X's current local time and time difference from Lille on timeanddate, check X's 10-day forecast on weather.com for the call day, then write an email to family@example.com summarising the call.
steps: On timeanddate.com, search the city and open its current local time page; note the time, time zone and difference from Lille
On weather.com, open the location search, type the city and pick the matching result
Open the 10 Day tab and read the forecast for the call day (conditions, high, low, chance of rain)
In mail, open New message and set To = family@example.com
Set Body = 'Calling {relative} on {day}. It is {time} {tz} in {city} now ({offset} Lille), forecast there: {conditions} {day}, high {high}°F, low {low}°F, {rain}% chance of rain.'
Send the email; the person discarded the draft each time in the recording

opportunities.name: Weekend stopover plan (city info + hotel + note)
opportunities.description: For a French city and a Saturday–Sunday date pair, find a landmark and the population on Wikipedia, search Booking.com for a one-night stay, pick the top hotel, and save a 'Stopover' note with the hotel, price, landmark and population.
steps: On Wikipedia, search the city and open its article; note the population and a main landmark
On Booking.com, click Enter destination, select all, type the city and pick the suggestion
Open the date picker (go to the next month if needed) and click the check-in Saturday and check-out Sunday
Open the top hotel result and note its name and nightly price
In Notes, add 'Stopover {city} {date}: {hotel} €{price}. See {landmark} (pop {population})' and press Enter

opportunities.name: Dinner plan: restaurant vs. recipe note
opportunities.description: For a cuisine and a London neighbourhood, find a restaurant on OpenTable and a matching dish on Allrecipes, then save a 'Dinner: out at X or cook Y' note with the rating, price, area and cooking time.
steps: On OpenTable, select the search box text and type '{cuisine} {area}', then press Enter
Open the top restaurant result and note its rating, price range and area
On Allrecipes, search for the dish
Open the top recipe result and note its total time
In Notes, add 'Dinner: out at {restaurant} ({rating}, {price}, {area}) or cook {recipe} ({time})' and press Enter

instances.values: Italian Islington -> Terra Rossa - Angel; lasagna -> Creamy Chicken Lasagna
Thai Soho -> Thai Tho - Soho; pad thai -> Pad Thai
Indian Shoreditch -> SPICE SLICE Shoreditch; chicken tikka masala -> Chicken Tikka Masala
